title: Balance TDARR codec container selection
summary: Added an opt-in TDARR balanced-selection mode that covers every available video-codec/container pair before filling the legacy per-bucket quota.
reason: Container-stress precedence hid codec diversity in the default bucket-only sample selection, allowing a supposedly broad test run to omit available codec/container combinations.
behavior_before: TDARR automatic sampling selected a fixed count per bucket and could represent only one codec inside container-stress.
behavior_after: The new --balanced-selection mode deterministically includes one sample per codec/container pair, then fills the bucket quota; it is opt-in so established command time budgets are unchanged.
manual_validation: bundled unittest TDARR matrix audit - passed (25 tests)
rollback_plan: Remove codec_container_key, select_balanced_sample_rows, the CLI flag, the regression test, generated summaries, and this packet to restore bucket-only selection.
notes:
Added explicit codec-container balanced selection and policy proof run-root fencing.
Covered balanced codec-container selection.
Refreshed generated summaries for balanced TDARR selection.
